notes: The index digest and both architecture manifest digests were verified with cosign against the pinned identity and issuer; upstream signs recursively, so the children carry signatures of their own.
The certificate's githubWorkflowSha matches the commit that the 4.46 tag resolves to, checked independently against the GitHub API.
Both binaries were confirmed statically linked by ELF inspection: no PT_INTERP and no PT_DYNAMIC segment, so neither carries a glibc version requirement.

The amd64 versionString was produced by executing the binary. The arm64 versionString is null because this record was produced on an amd64 host; it must be captured on a native arm64 runner before a release, and the arm64 binary was instead confirmed to embed both the large_disk marker and the release commit.
The upstream version number is computed at runtime from a numeric constant rather than stored as a string, so it cannot be found by searching the binary; only execution reveals it.
This record proves reviewed bytes and a verifiable publisher identity. It does not prove the absence of defects in the signed image.
